description: This is a C source file that demonstrates using libcurl's multi interface with a debug callback function. It sets up a curl request with verbose debug output, utilizing a custom dump function to print detailed HTTP communication data, and manages the multi handle to perform an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: void dump(const char * text,FILE * stream,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
methods.description: Outputs data in hex and ASCII format, optionally without hex, for debugging network data exchanges.

methods.name: int my_trace(CURL * handle,curl_infotype type,unsigned char * data,size_t size,void * userp)
methods.description: Custom callback for libcurl to handle debug information and call dump to output detail about transfer events.

methods.name: int main(void)
methods.description: Main function that initializes a curl easy handle, sets options including the debug callback, sets up a multi handle, adds the easy handle to the multi handle, and performs the download while printing debug information.
